limitations: Models the HEAD TOKEN-INTERSECTION lane only. The entity-phrase lane (e2:/e3:) and the prefix-head fallback can serve a record this probe calls EVICTED, so SERVABLE means 'reachable by the plain head path', not 'the deployed Worker returns it'.

Candidate packs are ALREADY capped per map task, so rank <= HEAD_RESULT_CAP is exact while a rank above it is a LOWER BOUND. The SERVABLE/EVICTED split only tests rank <= cap, so the split is sound; the printed rank magnitudes are not.
QUERY_REFUSED is release-invariant by construction and can never produce a delta; it is reported so it cannot masquerade as one.
ABSENT means absent near the expected point under a matching name. A badly geocoded gold coordinate looks identical.
Weak (containment / alt-name) tiers are carried but excluded from the headline delta.
